ProductDescription:
The Peter Rabbit™ Bamboo Rayon Muslin 2-Pack Swaddle Set wraps little ones in Beatrix Potter’s classic artwork with Saranoni’s soft, breathable muslin. These generously sized swaddles are made for wrapping and snuggling — a wearable nursery essential, not a throw blanket.

Choose a Boy/Neutral or Girl/Neutral pack. Each pack includes two coordinating muslin swaddles with high-quality construction designed to feel airy, cuddly, and soft against baby’s skin.

• Soft, airy, breathable muslin
• Generously sized at 47" x 47"
• Official Peter Rabbit™ collaboration
• Available as Boy Pack or Girl Pack

Care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle; do not bleach; tumble dry low.

Pair with a matching crib sheet, changing pad cover, or cotton quilt from the Peter Rabbit™ collection.
